claims.claim: healthy call returns 200 + CCS receipt header
L1 retry: failing upstream gets re-hit (backoff attempts)
L1 exhaust: final response still carries a receipt (fail-closed chain, no naked 5xx)
breaker trips: next call rejected with structured receipt, not naked 503
dignified refusal: rejection receipt contains breaker/ cooldown reason + correlation_id
after cooldown, single probe passes and chain continues
receipt chain continuity: every edge receipt prev_hash anchored + every edge receipt in chain log
